vamos-taxi.title: Vamos Taxi — Koussay Zayani
vamos-taxi.description: Booking system for a Swiss airport-transfer company. I cut a long checkout down to two steps and built the client site and the dispatcher dashboard.

looma-kitchen.title: Looma Kitchen — Koussay Zayani
looma-kitchen.description: Full restaurant system for a Dubai delivery kitchen. Guests order from the menu. The kitchen gets the ticket, assigns a chef, and the customer can follow the order out to delivery. Catering sits on the same product.

almar-private-journey.title: Almar Private Journey — Koussay Zayani
almar-private-journey.description: Brand and Framer site for a new private-travel studio. Services and experiences only. Guests request a consultation. No booking, no dashboard.

fido-homes.title: Fido Homes — Koussay Zayani
fido-homes.description: Brand and Framer site for a new Dubai real estate agency. A project showcase they can update from the CMS.

elysee-home-design.title: Élysée Home Design — Koussay Zayani
elysee-home-design.description: Brand and Framer site for a new Dubai interior design studio. A project showcase they can update from the CMS.

clickit-story.title: Clickit Story — Koussay Zayani
clickit-story.description: Streaming platform for a Dubai production agency. People watch their shows and exclusive content on their own site. The dashboard is connected and live.

artemis-luxe.title: Artemis Luxe — Koussay Zayani
artemis-luxe.description: Framer site for a new Dubai luxury brand studio. Her identity. I built the site so consultation actually works.
